name: Medad
overview: Medad was one of the seventy elders chosen by God to assist Moses, who, unlike most, did not go to the tabernacle but remained in the camp where the Spirit of God rested upon him, enabling him to prophesy. This event, recorded in Numbers 11:26-29, highlights that the Spirit’s empowering for prophecy was not confined to a specific location or group, as Medad and Eldad prophesied openly in the camp. Moses’ response to Joshua’s concern reveals a Christ-centered desire that all God's people might be filled with His Spirit and proclaim His word.
